thread:
maya: Quick follow-up from the recent postmortem (RED-incident-2026-03-12). I sketched remediation items and need owners + timelines. Noting a recurring pattern: KV cache churn + autoscaler jitter during bursty traffic.

maya: Action summary (short):
1) Reduce autoscale sensitivity + add cooldown (owner?) — ticket RED-3421
2) Add persistent prefix cache for hot routes (owner?) — ticket RED-3422
3) Run a chaos test to reproduce cache eviction at load (owner?) — ticket RED-3423

maya: RACI suggestion:
- Responsible: Eng-runtime (implement changes)
- Accountable: eng-sre oncall rotation (validation + rollout)
- Consulted: perf team (benchmarks)
- Informed: product + customer success (when rollout starts)

raj: I can take RED-3421 (autoscale tweak). ETA: PR by next Wed, rollout to staging Thurs, canary Fri. Will add details to the ticket. :thumbsup:

leo: I'll pick up RED-3422 (prefix cache). Need to sync with raj because cache config interacts with autoscale thresholds. Proposed owner pair: leo (primary), raj (backup).

sarah: For RED-3423 (chaos testing), ops has a template. I can own test harness and test plan. Timeline: draft plan Mon, run tests Tue/Wed next week.

maya: Perfect. Can each of you add a short acceptance criteria to your ticket? e.g., for RED-3421: no autoscale-triggered pod churn for 30m under 2x baseline RPS; latency P95 < 300ms.

raj: Added acceptance criteria to RED-3421 and linked perf dashboard. Command I used to assign:```jira assign RED-3421 to raj; comment "Owning autoscale tuning, will coordinate canary"```

devops-bot: Epic created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-3500 — contains RED-3421, RED-3422, RED-3423. Subtasks auto-linked.

leo: Note on handoff: after I push cache changes, I'll run a short smoke + compare KV miss rate via `curl -s https://metrics/api?m=kv_miss_rate` and post the graphs. If miss rate reduction < 20% we rollback.

sarah: For recurring incident patterns: I noticed similar spike on 2026-01-28 where cache TTL misconfiguration coincided with a customer batch job. Proposed recurring mitigation: add an anomaly alert on upstream burst (rate of new prefixes > X/min) and a runbook to throttle background backfills.

maya: Good call. Please add the anomaly alert as a chore in RED-3422 or create RED-3424 if needed. We should also schedule a 30-min handoff meeting after staging canary to verify signals.

raj: Meeting scheduled: `calendar invite -> Postmortem Follow-up: RED-3500 canary review` for Fri 09:30 PT. Invite includes eng-runtime, eng-sre, perf.

leo: I'll add a note in the ticket about handoff steps and who to ping: `@eng-sre oncall` + `@maya` for rollout approval.

maya: I'll own the RACI doc update and ensure customers on the affected list (customer-success) are pre-notified before full rollout. ETA for notification draft: Thu EOD.

sarah: Quick risk note: if the cache change reduces miss but increases memory pressure on GPUs we need to have fallback knob: `CACHE_EVICT_THRESHOLD` to revert. Add to rollout playbook.

maya: Agreed — add fallback steps in the ticket checklist.

raj: All set from my side. I'll post the staging metrics in-thread when canary runs.

leo: Will do.

devops-bot: Reminder: weekly remediation sync on Mon 10:00 PT — RED-3500 added to agenda.

maya: Thanks everyone. Closing loop: owners are raj (RED-3421), leo (RED-3422), sarah (RED-3423). Epic RED-3500 tracks end-to-end. If anything slips, ping here so we can reassign. :white_check_mark:
